capabilities: Store old file names in a configurable frontmatter property after renames
Optionally record old parent folder names when folders are renamed
Skip names matching user-defined ignore regex patterns
Restrict tracking to included or excluded folders and chosen file extensions
Auto-create the history property when it is missing
disambiguation: Not a version-history or backup tool; it only records old names in a property after renames happen.
extras: Part of the Vault CMS project; the README also promotes the developer's paid desktop writing app Zeku (14-day free trial).
motivation: The README says it is 'ideal for generating redirect rules (e.g., for Astro templates)', indicating the author built it to keep old names for static-site publishing.
problem: Obsidian does not record previous file or folder names after a rename, so old names are lost and cannot be used for redirects or lookups.

relations.evidence: Particularly helpful when used in conjunction with Astro Composer Obsidian plugin
and the Astro Modular blog theme

summary: Rename tracker that stores old file and folder names in a chosen frontmatter property (default: aliases) for use in redirect rules.
